werewolf.name: Werewolf
werewolf.power: Each night, wakes with the other werewolves and agrees on one player to kill.

villager.name: Simple Villager
villager.power: No special power: use your judgement to find the werewolves.

seer.name: Seer
seer.power: Each night, secretly learns the true role of one player.

witch.name: Witch
witch.power: Has one healing potion and one poison potion, each usable once per game at night.

hunter.name: Hunter
hunter.power: When eliminated, immediately shoots one other player, who is eliminated too.

cupid.name: Cupid
cupid.power: On the first night, makes two players lovers: if one dies, the other dies of grief.

little-girl.name: Little Girl
little-girl.power: May peek during the werewolves' turn, but dies instead of their victim if caught.

thief.name: Thief
thief.power: On the first night, may swap their card for one of the two leftover cards.

sheriff.name: Sheriff
sheriff.power: An elected title: the Sheriff's vote counts as two, and passes to a named successor.
